_ayuda: Escuela de Entrenadores (Ciudad Férrica), el doble de grande que la del juego. Ver data/LEEME_CAMPANA.txt para cambiar diálogos, duelos y premios. Letras de 'baldosas' (casillas de 16x16): '.' piso, '#' pared, 'E' pizarrón, 'M' escritorio, 'T' pupitre, 'P' maceta, 'D' puerta (la alfombra de abajo a la izquierda va a la biblioteca; la del medio, a la tienda). 'fondo' es la imagen del mapa entero (mundo/propios/escuela_rustboro.png, la arma tools/armar_escuela.py).
puerta: Outside the classroom is Bridgette's Card Shop.

dar: Today's lesson is about Special Conditions. Your Pokémon can be Burned, Paralyzed, Asleep, Confused or Poisoned.
If Special Conditions give you trouble, try these cards.
despues: A Pokémon recovers from Special Conditions when it evolves or when it moves to the Bench.
Some cards can help you out too!

dar: You beat our Headmaster? You learn fast! I think your skills can take you far.
I hope you keep growing as a Card Trainer.
Take this card as proof of that wish.
despues: The real challenges are out there, but you can still duel the other students as much as you like.

frases: Good morning! Come in, come in.
It's always nice to have more people who want to learn how to play.
I'm reading this book called 'Calendar', and it looks like next year's dates have been leaked!
Don't tell anyone, but New Year's Day is going to be on January 1st!
'How to take care of your Magcargo in winter'... now this is a good read.
According to this guide, your Pokémon takes double damage if it's weak to the opponent's attack!
Sounds like a good idea to have decks of different types...
Sorry, not right now. I'm imagining duel scenarios and worrying about them.
Hmm, according to this, there are 3 things you can only do once per turn: retreat your Active Pokémon, play a Supporter and attach an Energy from your hand.
I need to remember this...

dar: What? Of course I know what a damage counter is!
It's... uhmm... well, just think of what it equals. 1 damage counter is 10 damage, 2 damage counters are 20 damage, and so on. Simple!
despues: Oran Berry is a Pokémon Tool: it stays attached to your Pokémon until it's used.
What? You know what a Pokémon Tool is, right?

dar: Special Energy cards are like Basic Energy, but with an extra effect. Try this one out!
despues: Rainbow Energy counts as every type of Energy! There are other kinds of Special Energy too. You should check them out!

frases: Did you know? You can put as many Basic Energy cards in your deck as you want! But don't put in too many, you need other cards too!
Pokémon-ex cards are strong, but you give up 2 Prize cards when they're Knocked Out. Be careful!

dar: A friend told me Pokémon-ex cards are super strong, but... giving up 2 Prize cards for one is rough.
You know what, you can have my card. I don't think I'll use it.
